title: Principal
description: A long-lived cryptographic identity (an agent, an operator, or a verifier) identified by a stable id and an ed25519 public key.

principal_id.description: Stable, globally unique identifier for the principal.

public_key.description: Raw 32-byte ed25519 public key, standard base64 with padding (exactly 44 characters).

key_algorithm.description: Signature algorithm for public_key. Only ed25519 is defined by RFC-0001.

display_name.description: Optional human-readable name. Not unique, not trusted.

extensions.description: Open bag for vendor or profile extensions. Keys SHOULD be namespaced (e.g. 'vendor.example/field').
